digest.component_or_area: MCP HTTP service on AWS infrastructure
propositions: Rebar MCP requires an HTTP server exposed on AWS through nginx /mcp/ with loopback-only binding and static bearer token authentication for copilot/codex/claude clients.
Auto-deploy must use blue-green immutable-release pattern (new container start, atomic upstream flip, retire-when-idle) rather than stop-and-drain to avoid killing in-flight certified operations.

MCP container must sign plan-review and completion-verifier certificates under the existing opcert environment (env_id 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65) without introducing a new trusted environment.
Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized from SSM parameters as-code in ssm.tf, with gitignored local config templates, following opcert's secret guard pattern.

Code review operations remain verified through Gerrit LLM-Review vote, not opcert, preserving the single-op-cert-kind model while enabling plan-review and completion-verifier certification through MCP.

Flipping verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since into rebar.toml is deferred (requires local CLI update to sign under env 9f1c8e42), with an ADR amendment and runbook documenting the deferred operator step.
